**Question.** Can target prefill reuse weights across positions without reducing DFlash2 decode acceptance or throughput?

| setup | |
| --- | --- |
| node | gx10-5e36 head plus 192.168.100.11 peer |
| kernel | 6.17.13-rocket64k, 64 KiB |
| commit | 2d9c1eadb86e6dc9c0bc8416522d36b82b857ac8 |
| GPU | GB10, sm_121, 48 SM per rank |
| serving shape | c8, spec 8, 90 GiB expert cache per rank |

```bash
# Throughput and parity gate
PROMPT=$(python3 - <<'PY'
s=('Write a Python function that merges two sorted arrays without allocating a third array. Explain the loop invariant, handle duplicate values, and analyze the time complexity. Then compare the method with binary insertion. '
   'A satellite orbits Mars while a control system samples temperature, voltage, and angular velocity every millisecond. Summarize how numerical error can accumulate in the estimator. ')
print((s*4).strip())
PY
)

for mode in ref fast; do
  if [[ $mode == ref ]]; then chunk=1; else chunk=32; fi
  BATCH=8 SPEC=8 TOKENS=128 EXPERT_CACHE_GIB=90 MAX_TOKENS=1024 \
    PRELOAD_OWNED=1 PREFILL_CHUNK=$chunk PREFILL_TAIL=32 PROMPT="$PROMPT" \
    scripts/runtime/glm53-nvfp4-spec-bench.sh
 done

# GPU counters, capture range is prefill only
scripts/runtime/glm53-nvfp4-prefill-profile.sh
```

```text
ref:  prefill 45098.6 ms; decode 393.7 ms/step; 20.32 tok/s/stream; acceptance 100.0%
fast: prefill 12158.9 ms; decode 387.2 ms/step; 20.66 tok/s/stream; acceptance 100.0%
token comparison: identical
```

| chunk width, 168-token c8 control | prefill | change from prior width |
| ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | 26.551 s | reference |
| 2 | 14.692 s | -44.7% |
| 4 | 8.995 s | -38.8% |
| 8 | 6.179 s | -31.3% |
| 16 | 4.749 s | -23.1% |
| 32 | 4.232 s | -10.9% |
| 64 | 4.491 s | +6.1% |

The capture-range profile excludes model load and records only prefill. Width 64 is slower while SM issue remains 17.3%, so the retained limit is the measured shape knee.

Whole-prompt chunking reduced acceptance on the 17-token decode prompt at every tested width above one. A tail of eight still fell to 59.4% acceptance and 14.34 tok/s. The 32-token tail keeps prompts of 32 tokens or fewer on sequential prefill. The varied 280-token and default 17-token gates matched every generated token.

**Verdict.** Accept chunk 32 with a 32-token sequential tail. Width 64 is slower, and shorter whole-prompt shapes fail the decode-quality gate.

**Reopen if.**

- A CUDA, firmware, or GB-series hardware change moves the chunk-width knee above 32.
